jurisdictions.name: DeSoto County (Hernando, Southaven and Olive Branch area)
jurisdictions.office: Planning and Building Department, DeSoto County
jurisdictions.portal_name: DeSoto County Citizen Self Service Portal
notes: DeSoto County's Building office processes building permits and inspects residential, commercial and industrial buildings, and it licenses the county's general contractors, plumbers, electricians and mechanical contractors.
The county's Citizen Self Service Portal is used to submit applications, permits and plans to the Building and Planning Department and to track them.
Electrical, mechanical and plumbing permit applications can be downloaded and mailed or brought to the Planning and Building Department at 365 Losher Street, Suite 200, Hernando.

jurisdictions.name: Gulfport / Harrison County
jurisdictions.portal_name: Online Drop Box for Application Submissions
notes: Gulfport's Building Code Services handles plan reviews, permitting and inspections, and publishes separate general, electrical, plumbing and HVAC permit applications.
Applications are submitted as PDF files through the city's online drop box, or in person or by mail to 1410 24th Avenue.

The city's residential submission criteria ask for a site plan showing property dimensions, structure distances from property lines, special flood hazard areas with elevation certificates where required, and a drainage plan.

sources.title: Minimum Submission Criteria for Residential Building Development Permit (City of Gulfport)

jurisdictions.name: Ridgeland / Madison County
notes: Ridgeland posts a single Application for Building Permit covering new construction, alterations, excavation or site work and other structures.
The form asks whether the site is inside the 100 year floodplain and, if so, for the flood map panel number, base flood elevation and lowest floor elevation.
Ridgeland's permit page does not list a pool-specific application.

sources.title: Licenses, Forms, and Permits (City of Ridgeland)
Application for Building Permit (City of Ridgeland)

jurisdictions.name: Jackson / Hinds County
notes: Jackson says permits are required for many residential projects, including permits for accessory structures such as garages, decks and sheds, and that requirements vary with project scope.
The city says residential applications are reviewed for building code, zoning and safety compliance, with inspections at stages of the work and final approval required.
Jackson's residential page does not mention pools specifically and refers residents to the permitting office for application requirements.

sources.title: Residential Building and Permits (City of Jackson)
